<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Editor } from "@tiptap/vue-3";
import { computed, provide } from "vue";

import { toolbarKey } from "./core-context";
import { DEFAULT_EXTENSION_LABELS } from "./core-labels";
import type { ExtensionLabels } from "./core-labels";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    editor?: Editor | null;
    labels?: Partial<ExtensionLabels>;
  }>(),
  { editor: null }
);

provide(toolbarKey, {
  editor: computed(() => props.editor ?? null),
  labels: computed(() => ({ ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_LABELS, ...props.labels })),
});
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Image } from "@lucide/vue";
import type { Editor } from "@tiptap/vue-3";

import { useEditorState } from "../editor/composables";
import { useToolbar, useToolbarEditor } from "./core-context";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: string; editor?: Editor | null }>();

const { labels } = useToolbar();
const editor = useToolbarEditor(() => props.editor);

const disabled = useEditorState(editor, (edit) =>
  edit
    ? Boolean(
        edit.isDestroyed ||
          !edit.extensionManager.extensions.some(
            (extension) => extension.name === "imagePlaceholder"
          )
      )
    : true
);

const insert = () => {
  const current = editor.value;
  if (!current || current.isDestroyed || disabled.value) {
    return;
  }
  current.chain().focus().insertImagePlaceholder().run();
};
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    :aria-label="labels.image"
    :class="['ext-btn', 'ext-btn--icon-sm', props.class]"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :title="labels.image"
    @click="insert"
  >
    <Image />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverPortal,
  PopoverRoot,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "reka-ui";
import { ref } from "vue";

type Pill = { height: number; left: number; top: number; width: number };

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    open?: boolean;
    side?: "bottom" | "right";
    contentClass?: string;
  }>(),
  { open: false, side: "bottom" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ "update:open": [open: boolean] }>();

const pill = ref<Pill | null>(null);

const enter = (target: EventTarget | null) => {
  const item = (target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest?.(
    "[data-dropdown-item]"
  ) as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!item) {
    return;
  }
  pill.value = {
    height: item.offsetHeight,
    left: item.offsetLeft,
    top: item.offsetTop,
    width: item.offsetWidth,
  };
};
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverRoot :open="open" @update:open="emit('update:open', $event)">
    <PopoverTrigger as-child>
      <slot name="trigger" />
    </PopoverTrigger>
    <PopoverPortal>
      <PopoverContent
        :side="props.side"
        :align="props.side === 'right' ? 'center' : 'start'"
        :side-offset="4"
        role="menu"
        data-ext-floating
        :class="['ext-dropdown-content', props.contentClass]"
        @mouseover="enter($event.target)"
        @focus="enter($event.target)"
        @mouseleave="pill = null"
      >
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          :class="[
            'ext-dropdown-pill',
            pill && 'ext-dropdown-pill--visible',
          ]"
          :style="pill ?? undefined"
        />
        <slot />
      </PopoverContent>
    </PopoverPortal>
  </PopoverRoot>
</template>
